caption: The drawing features four objects arranged with ample space between them on an off-white background. In the upper left area, there is a sphere shaded in gray pencil with a pattern of wavy, concentric lines covering its surface. Below and slightly to the right of this patterned sphere is a small jug or creamer outlined in pencil, on top of which rests a shaded sphere similar in style to the upper left object, but without a pattern. To the right side of the image, there is a large, reddish-brown sphere rendered with shading and two reflected highlights, giving it a glossy appearance. The objects are primarily drawn using pencil and shades of gray, with the reddish-brown sphere being the only element depicted in color. The artist's signature and the note "½ size" appear in the lower right corner.
title: Witch Ball
